text:
incident-bot: Pager alert: canary eu-west-1 serving cluster spike — 503 rate up 15% (P1). Deploy tag=rollout/variant-B. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/3167890123

rosa: Oncall here, looking. Saw the spike at 09:13 UTC. Pulling logs from canary pod-7a.

rosa: kubectl logs canary-pod-7a -n inference | tail -n 50
rosa: "OOMKilled
2026-03-17T09:12:57Z worker: alloc failed for 2048MB
model-serving: commit abc1234"

mike: That commit is the tokenizer patch + small mem tweak. Didn't expect OOM. Reproducing locally now.

rosa: Rolling down traffic to 10% for variant-B, routing remainder to stable. Metrics: 503s dropped slightly but still noisy.

helena: Customer A (acct 8472) reporting errors in prod via support channel. CS starting template message.

mike: If traffic reduction doesn't stabilize, recommend flipping feature flag `new-tokenizer-v2` off. It's a server-side flag in feature-store.

rosa: Can we flip? @mike /deploy-bot any gotchas?

mike: No DB migration behind it. Flipping now: curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"new-tokenizer-v2","state":"off"}' || echo flip-failed

deploy-bot: Flag flip executed by mike at 09:21 UTC — new-tokenizer-v2=off.

rosa: Observability: error rate down ~80% within 90s after flip. Latency back to expected. Great work.

jay: I'll take monitoring for the next 30m, watch SSE and kv-cache hit rates. Handing off from rosa.

rosa: Next step: safe rollback of the single commit abc1234 — prefer `git revert` + small canary deploy. Mike, can you prepare the revert patch?

mike: prepping revert: git checkout main && git revert --no-edit abc1234 && git push origin main && trigger ci.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for revert (pipeline id: 8821). Staging smoke tests passing.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy of revert to eu-west-1 started at 09:29 UTC (5% traffic).

rosa: Canary looks healthy for 10 minutes. Increasing to 50%. 503s remain at baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout of revert complete at 09:36 UTC. Traffic moved to stable variant.

incident-bot: Incident resolved — mitigations: feature flag flip + single-commit revert (abc1234). Duration 00:23:27. Severity downgraded to P0.

aaron: Thanks — hold on external comms until we draft a short note. Helena, coordinate with CS on customer messaging.

helena: Will do, sending customer A an update that we mitigated the issue and are doing follow-up.

rosa: Quick follow-up items: add automated memory regression check to preflight, add a canary CPU/mem alert threshold, and schedule a postmortem tomorrow 10:00. Assigning to mike + jay.

jay: Ack, standing by for handoff monitoring and will join postmortem.

mike: I'll prepare revert PR notes and a bisect plan to isolate the tokenizer change.

rosa: Closing channel for now. If anything abnormal in the next hour ping @rosa or @jay. :white_check_mark:
